item.title: Anua’s ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ K-Beauty Collection Is 25% Off on Amazon for Prime Day
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends. Today, we're talking about a unique collaboration that's bringing K-pop and skincare together. Netflix's K-pop Demon Hunters franchise has teamed up with Korean skincare brand Anua, and we're excited to share the details with you."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Anua x K-pop Demon Hunters collection is now discounted up to 25% on Amazon as part of their Prime Day sale. This is a great opportunity to try out some of their popular products, including the Ceramide Barrier Collagen Mask, which is infused with nourishing ingredients for long-lasting hydration and skin repair."
[Short sound effect]
Host: "We've also got our eyes on the Vita Collagen Mask, which features a 'Golden'-inspired backing film and helps to improve skin firmness and brightness. And for those pesky pimples, the Anua Ultra-Thin Spot Cover Patch is a must-try. These acne dots are inspired by the characters from the movie and work to absorb excess oil while soothing irritated skin."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But that's not all - the collection also includes two sunscreens, the Zero-Cast Moisturizing Sunscreen SPF 50 and the Invisible Matte Finish Sunscreen. Both are bestselling products and are now discounted up to 25% on Amazon. With over 8,000 people purchasing the Zero-Cast Moisturizing Sunscreen in the last month alone, it's clear that this collaboration is a hit."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you're interested in trying out these products, be sure to check out the links in our show notes. And remember, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through their retail links, but all products and services featured are independently chosen by editors."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
